name: voice-loop
description: Two-way voice for Claude Code with pluggable speech providers: a config registry picks OpenAI, ElevenLabs or Deepgram per direction, or keeps every clip local/self-hosted (faster-whisper STT; Silero, XTTS-v2 or Ukrainian TTS on the bundled server) — switching backends is a config entry, never a code change. A Stop hook speaks the lines Claude marks, a push-to-talk hotkey dictates into your prompt, and /voice-setup installs it all.  Requires sill-core (install both: /plugin install voice-loop@windowsill && /plugin install sill-core@windowsill).

tts_api_key.title: Cloud TTS API key
tts_api_key.description: API key for the cloud TTS provider selected by `tts.cloud.provider` (OpenAI, ElevenLabs, Deepgram or compatible). Stored in the secure credential store; the voice-loop MCP server holds it and is the ONLY reader. Sensitive.

stt_api_key.title: Cloud STT API key
stt_api_key.description: API key for the cloud STT provider selected by `stt.cloud.provider` (OpenAI, Deepgram or compatible). Stored in the secure credential store; the voice-loop MCP server holds it and is the ONLY reader. Sensitive.
